modules.title: Agentic Workflows
modules.description: Go beyond simple automation and learn to architect intelligent systems. In this course, you'll master the art of designing and building agentic workflows using Python. You'll explore core patterns like Prompt Chaining, Routing, and Parallelization to create teams of AI agents that can reason, plan, and act to solve complex problems. You will finish by building a complete, agentic project management system, proving your ability to translate high-level goals into powerful, adaptive AI solutions.
modules.project: AI-Powered Agentic Workflow for Project Management

lessons.title: Introduction to Agentic Workflows
lessons.description: Introduces the foundational concepts of AI agents and agentic workflows, setting the stage for the course. It covers prerequisites, the course environment, and how to use the necessary API keys.

lessons.title: Understanding Agentic Workflows
lessons.description: Explores what defines a modern AI agent, its core components (Persona, Knowledge, Tools, Interaction), and the different types of agents based on their LLM interaction model.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Modeling
lessons.description: Design and visualize agentic workflows.  Learn common agent types as building blocks for creating visual workflow diagrams.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Workflow Modeling
lessons.description: Design and visualize agentic workflows.  Learn common agent types as building blocks for creating visual workflow diagrams.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Implementation
lessons.description: Covers the practical aspects of translating agentic workflow models into Python code. Students learn to structure agent logic, define agent classes, and orchestrate their interactions.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns:  Prompt Chaining Workflow
lessons.description: Introduces the Prompt Chaining pattern for breaking down complex tasks into a sequence of smaller, dependent steps. It covers strategies for task decomposition, validation, and context management.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Prompt Chaining Workflows with Python
lessons.description: Provides hands-on experience in implementing the Prompt Chaining pattern. Students build a multi-agent chain to solve a problem where information is passed sequentially.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns: Routing
lessons.description: Teaches the Routing pattern, which involves classifying incoming tasks and directing them to the most appropriate specialized agent or processing path.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Routing Workflows with Python
lessons.description: Students implement a routing system where a router agent uses an LLM to classify a query and then dispatches it to the correct specialist agent, which may involve orchestrating sub-tasks.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns: Parallelization
lessons.description: Introduces the Parallelization pattern for executing multiple agent tasks concurrently. It covers strategies for task decomposition (sharding, aspect-based) and result aggregation.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Parallelization Workflows with Python
lessons.description: Students implement a parallel workflow using Python's threading module, where multiple specialist agents analyze a document concurrently, and a synthesizer agent combines their findings.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns:  Evaluator-Optimizer Workflow
lessons.description: Focuses on the Evaluator-Optimizer pattern, an iterative process of generation, critique, and refinement to improve output quality. It emphasizes clear evaluation criteria and actionable feedback.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Evaluator-Optimizer Workflows with Python
lessons.description: Students build a two-agent system (a creator and a critic) that works in a loop. The creator generates a solution, and the critic provides feedback until the solution meets all constraints.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflow Patterns Orchestrator-Workers Workflow
lessons.description: Introduces the advanced Orchestrator-Workers pattern, where a central agent dynamically plans, delegates, and synthesizes the work of multiple specialized worker agents.

lessons.title: Implementing Agentic Orchestrator-Workers Pattern in Python
lessons.description: Students implement a market analysis report generator where an Orchestrator agent creates a plan, assigns tasks to news, competitor, and trend analysis workers, and then synthesizes their findings.

lessons.title: Course Review
lessons.description: Course review.

lessons.title: AI-Powered Agentic Workflow for Project Management
lessons.description: In this project you'll build a comprehensive, reusable library of different agent types and then use them to create a multi-step agentic workflow to manage a technical project.

Create data-driven agents that interact with external APIs, search the web, query SQL databases, and perform agentic RAG for dynamic retrieval. Learn to evaluate agent performance for reliable, real-world applications.

title: Agentic AI Engineer with LangChain and LangGraph

modules.label: Course 1
modules.title: LangChain Agentic AI Fundamentals
modules.description: This course provides a comprehensive overview of building intelligent agentic applications using LangChain. Participants will learn to create simple LangChain applications and explore structured outputs. The curriculum progresses through multi-step workflows, transitioning from LLM calls to developing agents, and covers essential agentic design patterns. Key concepts include extending agents with tools, managing functions, and understanding state management within LangGraph. Students will also implement short-term agent memory techniques and complete a hands-on project: building a report-generating agent.

lessons.title: Course Introduction & Setup
lessons.description: Get introduced to the course, meet your instructors, and learn how to set up and use your Vocareum OpenAI API key and assigned budget for hands-on activities.

lessons.title: Creating a Simple LangChain application
lessons.description: Learn to build a simple LangChain app: integrate LLMs, manage chat history, use prompt templates, and apply few-shot prompting to create customizable chatbots with memory.

lessons.title: Structured Outputs
lessons.description: Discover structured outputs in AI: transform responses into actionable JSON for integration. Utilize schemas, parsers, and function calls to enhance reliability and automation in workflows.

lessons.description: Learn to parse and structure LLM outputs in LangChain using output parsers, TypedDict, Pydantic models, and automatic error correction for robust workflows.

lessons.title: Multi-Step Workflows in LangChain
lessons.description: Learn to build flexible, multi-step AI workflows in LangChain using Runnables and LCEL for composing, batching, and managing complex chains with ease and scalability.

lessons.title: From LLM Calls to Agents
lessons.description: Explore how AI evolves from basic LLM calls to fully autonomous agents, learn agentic frameworks, applications, and how to design effective agent-driven workflows.

lessons.title: Agentic Design Patterns
lessons.description: Discover four key agentic design patterns—reflection, tool use, planning, and multi-agent collaboration—to boost LLM performance and reliability in complex tasks.

lessons.title: Extending Agents with Tools
lessons.description: Extend AI agents beyond text with tool integrations, enabling reliable real-time actions and data access.

lessons.title: Functions as Tools in LangChain
lessons.description: Learn how to encapsulate Python functions as tools in LangChain, enabling LLMs to call functions, interact with APIs, and handle external computations in AI workflows.

lessons.title: Agentic Workflows with LangGraph
lessons.description: Learn to build dynamic, agent-driven AI workflows using LangGraph, leveraging nodes, edges, and routing for modular, adaptive application control and automation.

lessons.title: Agent State Management
lessons.description: Explore agent state management with state machines. Learn how agents track user input, instructions, and tool use for complex workflows, ensuring adaptability and reliability.

lessons.title: LangGraph State Management
lessons.description: Learn structured state management in LangGraph for robust AI workflows, with focus on TypedDicts, reducers, routing, handlers, persistence, and practical multi-turn agent design.

lessons.title: Short-Term Agent Memory
lessons.description: Explore short-term memory in AI agents, enhancing coherence via state, ephemeral, and ephemeral memory strategies for efficient context retention in active sessions.

lessons.title: LangGraph Agent Memory
lessons.description: Learn how LangGraph uses checkpointers and threads for agent memory, allowing persistent, isolated, and customizable conversations with snapshots, time travel, and personalized assistance.

lessons.title: Project: Report-Building Agent
lessons.description: Build a document processing system using LangChain/LangGraph. You'll create an AI assistant that answers questions, summarize documents, and perform calculations on financial and healthcare documents.

modules.label: Course 2
modules.title: Building AI Agents with LangGraph
modules.description: This course guides learners through the essentials of implementing intelligent agents using LangGraph. Learners will explore external tools and APIs, and learn how to integrate them effectively within their agents. Key lessons include interacting with databases and implementing LangGraph Database Agents for efficient data retrieval. The course covers advanced topics like Retrieval Augmented Generation, incorporating human-in-the-loop strategies, and ensuring agent observability and reliability. Finally, learners will apply these concepts in a hands-on project, designing an Energy Advisor agent, which synthesizes their knowledge into a practical application.

lessons.description: Learn to integrate external APIs as tools in LangChain via LangGraph, enabling agents to fetch real-time data and enrich LLM responses using structured workflows and router logic.

lessons.description: Explore human-in-the-loop and observability techniques to monitor, debug, and optimize AI agents, ensuring oversight, transparency, and reliable performance at scale.

modules.label: Course 3
modules.title: Advanced Agentic AI Techniques
modules.description: This course equips learners with the essential skills and knowledge to design and implement sophisticated agent-based systems. The course covers long-term memory integration within agents, emphasizing the LangGraph framework. Participants explore multi-agent architectures and state management, focusing on effective orchestration and data routing. Through hands-on projects, learners will implement agentic systems, culminating in the development of an Autonomous Knowledge Agent.
